en.headline: Coleman Wong exits US Open after first-round loss to Tommy Paul
en.dek: The Hong Kong qualifier took the opening set in a tie-break on Louis Armstrong Stadium, then dropped the next three against the 20th seed.
body: Coleman Wong of Hong Kong lost in the first round of the US Open men's singles on Sunday, falling 7-6 (7-3), 1-6, 3-6, 3-6 to 20th seed Tommy Paul of the United States after two hours and 41 minutes on Louis Armstrong Stadium.

Wong, who came through three qualifying rounds, saved a set point in the 10th game of the first set and won the tie-break 7-3. Paul then broke serve repeatedly in the second set and kept control through the third and fourth. Wong hit 15 aces to Paul's nine but also recorded six double faults.

The 22-year-old is ranked around 94th in the world. Last year he became the first Hong Kong man in the Open era to reach a Grand Slam main draw and went on to the third round in New York. Compatriot Eudice Chong is due to play the women's doubles with China's Yang Zhaoxuan; the draw is scheduled for 1 September.

zh.headline: 黃澤林美網男單首圈不敵保羅 先贏一盤後遭逆轉
zh.dek: 港將在路易斯阿姆斯壯球場搶七先下一城，其後連輸三盤，以盤數1比3止步20號種子。
body: 香港網球手黃澤林周日在美國網球公開賽男單首輪，以7比6（7比3）、1比6、3比6、3比6不敵美國20號種子保羅，賽事在路易斯阿姆斯壯球場進行，耗時2小時41分鐘。
黃澤林經三輪資格賽晉身正賽。首盤第10局破掉對手的發球勝盤局，搶七以7比3先勝一盤，但其後發球局多次被破。他轟出15記Ace，多過對手的9記，同時有6次雙誤。
現年22歲的黃澤林世界排名約第94。他去年成為公開賽年代首位打入大滿貫正賽的香港男選手，並打入美網32強。港將張瑋桓將夥拍中國的楊釗煌出戰女雙，抽籤定於9月1日進行。
